biggest_catch: A 17-hour minimum Election Day (5am-10pm, closing can run later) for a $250-$300 stipend; the $50 training class payment is separate.
catches: Must be registered to vote in Oneida County, at least 17 years old, not an elected official or candidate.
Half-day shifts are possible but not guaranteed.
Stipend rates set by the Oneida County Board of Legislators.
The $50 training class payment is NOT in the figures: training duration is unstated, so it is excluded from both payout and time.
Closing can run past 10:00 p.m. until all closing procedures are completed; 1,020 minutes is a minimum, not a maximum.

c1.evidence: Oneida County Board of Elections official site (oneidacountynyvotes.gov): currently recruiting for upcoming elections.

c2.evidence: Official rates: Inspector $250, Coordinator $275, Technical Inspector $300 for a full Election Day (5am-10pm minimum, closing can exceed 10pm); $50 training class payment separate.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

eligibility: Registered voter in Oneida County, NY; at least 17; not an elected official/candidate or close relative of a district candidate; available for paid training class.
notes: Range covers the three official roles on a full Election Day (5am-10pm minimum; closing can exceed 10pm). The $50 training class payment is excluded from both payout and time because the training duration is unstated.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($250-$300 full Election Day stipend); time: 5:00am-10:00pm = 1020 min minimum; closing can run past 10pm until all closing procedures complete (unbounded above); $50 training class payment excluded from both (duration unstated)
payout_quote: Training Class attendance - $50.00; Inspector - $250.00; Coordinator - $275.00; Technical Inspector - $300.00. These rates are based on work for a full Election Day from 5:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m. or until all of the closing procedures have been completed.
payout_value_note: Full Election Day role stipend: Inspector $250, Coordinator $275, Technical Inspector $300. The $50 training class payment is separate (duration unstated, excluded from both).

steps: Be a registered voter in Oneida County, NY, at least 17 years old.
Sign up online or call (315) 798-5765 / email BoardofElections@oneidacountyny.gov.
Serve a full Election Day, 5:00am until 10:00pm (Inspector $250; Coordinator $275; Technical Inspector $300).
timing: Election Day (full day 5:00am-10:00pm); training in advance.
